summary.text: Moshe Landman is the Green Party nominee for Maryland's 6th Congressional District. An attorney and business founder with a background in real estate finance and artificial intelligence consulting, he previously ran for the Maryland State Senate in 2022. He describes his priorities as environmental repair, caring for people in need, and fiscal reform.

paragraphs.text: Landman was born in Washington, D.C.; according to his Ballotpedia survey, he grew up in Wheaton, Maryland, and is the son of a Silver Spring rabbi.

He earned a high school diploma from the Hebrew Academy of Greater Washington, a bachelor's degree from Yeshiva University in 2000, a graduate degree from George Mason University in 2003 (described in his survey as an M.B.A.), and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center in 2006.
Landman works as an attorney (he describes himself as licensed in New York), commercial mortgage broker, and artificial intelligence consultant.

He founded Landman Law, Maryland Metal (a precious metal dealer), and Maryland Medicinals (a wellness company), and says he was appointed a voting member of the Montgomery County Forest Conservation Advisory Committee.
Landman ran as the Green Party candidate for Maryland State Senate District 39 in 2022, losing to Sen. Nancy King, 12.3% to 86.2%.
He did not receive the Green Party nomination for this House seat in 2024.
